cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Operating leases appear tied to continued business use; not mechanically deducted from detachable cash, but reflected in cash-flow/profit quality.
cash_breakdown.reason: Disclosed separately because IFRS lease liabilities are financing-classified, while ordinary operating leases should not automatically reduce surplus cash under a going-concern control case.

profit_quality.assessment: Cash conversion is acceptable: operating cash flow was positive in 2023, 2024 and 2025, and FCF after PPE capex was HKD64.203m, HKD48.519m and HKD79.084m respectively. The denominator uses the three-year median FCF after PPE capex, not the best year or simple 2025 reported profit.
adjustments: Excluded the small 2025 PPE disposal gain of HKD0.080m from recurring profit.
Did not use the 2024 reported loss mechanically because it included a HKD90.000m one-time non-cash impairment and related deferred tax effect.
Used HKD64.203m as pre-haircut distributable cash profit, equal to the 2023-2025 median of operating cash flow less PPE capex.
Applied 0.85 profit haircut for local beer-market contraction, largest-customer concentration above 50%, capex needs and partial Mainland cash/remittance exposure.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Stable positive operating cash flow supports a high but not full factor; beer volume pressure and customer concentration keep the factor below 0.90.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Median FCF after PPE capex is below 2025 parent profit but still substantial; cash conversion is not a blocking issue.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed; annual PPE purchase cash flow is used as a conservative proxy.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2025 working capital was supportive overall: inventories decreased, receivables increased, and related-party balances/payables had mixed movements.
